avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May enhance immune activation and potentially increase risk of immune-related adverse events (irAEs) with checkpoint inhibitors
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; counsel patient to discontinue prior to nivolumab therapy

avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Vitamin C (>2000 mg/day)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May have immunomodulatory effects that could interfere with checkpoint inhibitor mechanism of action and increase irAEs
avoid_supplements.action: Limit to recommended dietary amounts; avoid megadose supplementation during treatment

avoid_supplements.name: Medicinal Mushrooms (Reishi, Maitake, Shiitake)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent immune stimulants that may exacerbate immune activation and increase risk of severe irAEs
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated during nivolumab therapy; discontinue before treatment initiation

caution_supplements.name: Probiotics
caution_supplements.mechanism: May influence gut microbiota composition which plays a role in immunotherapy response; some evidence suggests potential benefit but requires monitoring
caution_supplements.action: Use cautiously under clinical supervision; monitor for any changes in immune-related adverse events

caution_supplements.name: Omega-3 Fatty Acids
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild immunomodulatory effects; generally well-tolerated but may theoretically influence checkpoint inhibitor efficacy
caution_supplements.action: Monitor patient tolerance; maintain consistent dosing if used

caution_supplements.name: Curcumin/Turmeric
caution_supplements.mechanism: Has immunomodulatory and anti-inflammatory properties that could theoretically affect checkpoint inhibitor mechanism
caution_supplements.action: Use in moderation; inform healthcare provider if taking supplemental doses

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit and Grapefruit Juice
caution_foods.mechanism: While nivolumab is not CYP3A4 metabolized, concurrent medications for managing irAEs may be affected; grapefruit can inhibit drug transporters
caution_foods.action: Not absolutely contraindicated but avoid excessive consumption; inform provider if consuming regularly

caution_foods.name: High-fiber diet (>50g/day)
caution_foods.mechanism: May significantly alter gut microbiota composition, which influences immunotherapy response and irAE risk
caution_foods.action: Maintain consistent dietary fiber intake; discuss fiber supplementation plans with healthcare team

monitoring_notes: Nivolumab is not hepatically metabolized and has minimal direct drug interactions; however, immune-related adverse events (irAEs) are the primary concern with immune-stimulating supplements and dietary components affecting gut microbiota. Monitor for signs of autoimmune toxicity including colitis, pneumonitis, hepatitis, and endocrinopathies, and coordinate supplementation decisions with the oncology team managing checkpoint inhibitor therapy.
